lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in approximately 5-6 visible vertical columns posterior to the gills; spot diameter and inter-spot distance increase progressively toward the posterior frame edge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible, aligned with the vertical columns of spots, creating a rectilinear grid-like appearance where spots act as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank; the upper ridge exhibits a sharp transition from high luminance on its superior edge to shadow on its inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated cluster of small, high-luminance spots on the distal two-thirds of the visible pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced spots on the primary flank.
